basic_details.job_title: DNHDD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 State Mission Manager, City Mission Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two contractual posts, one State Mission Manager (SMM) and one City Mission Manager (CMM), are open under the PM SVANidhi Scheme in the U.T. of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu. Applications in the prescribed format go to the Joint Secretary-cum-Director, Urban Development Department, Secretariat, 4th Floor, Vidhyut Bhavan, Kachigam, Daman (UT) – 396 215, by hand, speed post or courier, from 16 November 2026 to on or before 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

important_instructions: The engagement is contractual, on a consolidated salary. The selected candidate will not have any right or claim for regularization against regular posts or vacancy. The declaration in the form says that information found suppressed, false or incorrect, or ineligibility detected before or after the examination/ interview, can lead to cancellation of candidature or engagement. content_sections.heading: DNH&DD Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, Urban Development Department, Daman
State Mission Manager (SMM); City Mission Manager (CMM)
Consolidated salary: SMM ₹75,000/- per month; CMM ₹55,000/- per month
SMM: post-graduate degree with 5 years' experience; CMM: graduate degree with 3 years' experience, in the fields listed below
U.T. of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Postal address as printed: Joint Secretary-cum-Director, Urban Development Department, Secretariat, 4th Floor, Vidhyut Bhavan, Kachigam, Daman (UT) – 396 215. The notice states the time limit as "upto 5:00 pm" and does not say whether the date is for receipt or dispatch.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: post-graduate degree in Management, Urban Planning, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Economics, or a related field. Experience: minimum 05 years of professional experience. Age: maximum age shall not be more than 45 years (as on the last date for application). Qualification: graduate degree in Management, Urban Planning, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Economics, or a related field. Experience: minimum 03 years of professional experience. Age: maximum age shall not be more than 45 years (as on the last date for application). The notice asks for work experience of programme implementation, planning and monitoring, preferably in these domains: Urban development, poverty alleviation, livelihood promotion, or micro-enterprise development. Projects supported by the Government of India, State Governments, autonomous bodies, multilateral/ bilateral agencies etc. The age limit is counted on the last date for application, which the application format gives as 30 November 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. For the exact eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: One passport size photograph, pasted on the application. Self-attested copies of all relevant educational qualification certificates. Self-attested copies of work experience certificates. Self-attested copies of caste and domicile certificates. A "No Objection Certificate" from the concerned authority, for a person already in service with Government or other organisations.

rows.details: Prescribed form to be sent by hand, speed post or courier

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are in the DNH&DD PM SVANidhi recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 State Mission Manager (SMM) and 1 City Mission Manager (CMM).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM, to the Joint Secretary-cum-Director, Urban Development Department, Daman.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for State Mission Manager?
faq.answer: A post-graduate degree in Management, Urban Planning, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Economics, or a related field, with minimum 05 years of professional experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for City Mission Manager?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in Management, Urban Planning, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Economics, or a related field, with minimum 03 years of professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age shall not be more than 45 years, as on the last date for application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for SMM and CMM?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is ₹75,000/- per month for State Mission Manager and ₹55,000/- per month for City Mission Manager.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application format, paste one passport size photograph, attach self-attested documents, and send it by hand, speed post or courier to the Urban Development Department, Secretariat, 4th Floor, Vidhyut Bhavan, Kachigam, Daman (UT) – 396 215.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is contractual, and the selected candidate will have no right or claim for regularization against regular posts or vacancy.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational qualification, work experience, caste and domicile certificates, plus a No Objection Certificate if the applicant is already in Government or other organisation service.

faq.question: Q10. Will call letters be sent by post?
faq.answer: No interview call letters will be sent to eligible candidates by post. The notice asks applicants to refer to https://ddd.gov.in for further updates.
